import smtplib

from email import encoders

msg["To"] = "bob@example.com"
msg["Subject"] = "Customer Activity Report - Maya Chen"

        server.sendmail("assistant@localhost", "bob@example.com", msg.as_string())

            capture_output=True, text=True
        )

from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF

def sanitize(text):
    """Replace non-Latin-1 characters with ASCII equivalents."""
    replacements = {
        "\\u2014": "--",   # em-dash
        "\\u2013": "-",    # en-dash
        "\\u2018": "'",    # left single quote
        "\\u2019": "'",    # right single quote
        "\\u201c": '"',    # left double quote
        "\\u201d": '"',    # right double quote
        "\\u2026": "...",  # ellipsis
        "\\u2022": "*",    # bullet
        "\\u00a0": " ",    # non-breaking space
    }
    for uni, ascii_eq in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(uni, ascii_eq)
    # Fallback: replace any remaining non-latin1 chars
    return text.encode("latin-1", errors="replace").decode("latin-1")

doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)

    elif "Email:" in text or "Loyalty" in text:

        pdf.cell(0, 6, text, new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
    else:
